children: On September 14, 2026, the company notified Nasdaq it will voluntarily withdraw its listing and transfer to the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE). Nasdaq trading is expected to end after market close on October 7, 2026, with TXSE trading beginning October 8, 2026. The common stock will trade as TCBI initially and is expected to switch to TXCP on November 9, 2026 (preferred to TCBI PRB then TXCP PRB).
